name: img
description: The pictures a page can carry: the reader, done the way this project reads everything —the file is the caller's bytes, the rows come out four bits a pixel, and there is no allocation of its own— and the writer of the one picture the system has to hand back, an eight-bit grey PNG with a stored zlib stream, so an app can export what it drew without owning a compressor (docs/30, docs/75).
